hooks.command: BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo "HEAD~1"); DIFF=$(git diff "$BASE"..HEAD 2>/dev/null); if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then LEAKS_OUT=$(gitleaks git --no-banner 2>&1); EC=$?; [ $EC -ne 0 ] && LEAKS="$LEAKS_OUT" || LEAKS=""; else LEAKS=$(printf "%s" "$DIFF" | grep -E "^\+[^+]" | grep -iE "(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|private[_-]?key|credential|aws_secret_access_key|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36})" 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$LEAKS" ]; then printf "%s" "$LEAKS" | head -10 | jq -Rs "{\"continue\":false,\"stopReason\":(\"🚨 시크릿 의심 패턴 발견 — PR을 중단합니다.\\n\\n\" + . + \"\\n확인 후 git history에서 제거하세요.\")}"; else printf "{\"continue\":true}\n"; fi
